column2: "The density of the Alter Factor in the outlying areas have dropped! The gate's energy readings appears to be fluctuating, affecting the enemies that appear!"
"The gate's energy readings appears to be fluctuating again! Let us continue!"
"The enemies' energy readings are still rather powerful. Keep defeating the enemies that appear!"
"The surrounding Alter Factor density has dropped further! Please continue to defeat the surrounding enemies."
"The gate's energy readings has drastically changed! It's affecting the enemies that appear!"
"Factor density has dropped even lower! It's causing a disturbance in the gate's energy readings."
"It looks like its heavily affecting the gate! Please continue to defeat enemies around you."
"There is a significant drop in Factor density! It seems the tide of the battle is turning in our favor!"
"A massive structure resembling a gate has appeared!\u3000Powerful enemies are expected to appear. Defeat the surrounding enemies to tip the scales of battle!"
"Powerful enemies will pour in from the gate! Prepare yourself for a fight!"
"Confirmed the defeat of a powerful enemy! Let us continue exploring, great work!"
"Defeat the boss enemy that came from the gate"
